coordinator#1 · hotlong · session_85eb0287cb754f0f9c2bed54cab9abff

第一阶段已拆卡（2026-11-21T14:44Z）。维护者：「可以，拆第一阶段」。

父单清单里第一阶段是六项，拆成了三张卡，因为去掉顶栏的同时必须把上面的东西安置好，分开做会出现中间状态：

| 卡 | 对应清单 | 内容 | 依赖 |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#36111 | 第 3、4 项 | 报表和自定义页面补统一头部；右上角按钮组（评论、编辑应用、AI、帮助）。顶栏还在时按钮组默认不显示 | 无，先做 |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#36112 | 第 1、2、6 项 | 去掉顶栏；侧栏常驻可收起；应用名、搜索、头像进侧栏；应用菜单只做换应用；提示条移到内容区顶部。专题里最大的一张 | #36111 |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#36113 | 第 5 项 | 列表页顶部改成两行 | #36111 |

一处过渡安排（协调席定的）：通知铃在 #36112 里先放在侧栏搜索框右边；第二阶段「首页」做好后由侧栏第一项「首页」的数字取代，届时去掉。平台首页 `/home` 在第一阶段保持能打开。

第二、第三阶段没有拆。

- 现在可派发的三张：objectstack-ai/objectstack#36111（页面头部和右上角按钮组，无依赖，先做）、objectstack-ai/objectstack#36112（去掉顶栏、侧栏常驻，依赖 #36111）、objectstack-ai/objectstack#36113（列表页顶部两行，依赖 #36111）。
- 第二、第三阶段没有拆卡，不在这次派发范围内。

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

## 维护者速读
第二阶段收窄了：侧栏不加「首页」，也不做首页 AI 输入框。侧栏的铃铛就是唯一的待办和通知入口。平台首页下线，登录直接进上次用的应用。第二阶段只剩一张卡，见下。
要你做的：无。

## Phase 2 narrowed — maintainer ruling 2026-11-23 14:30Z

The maintainer's words, in order:
- 14:25Z 「我记得有一个任务是去掉首页，登录之后自动跳转到第一个应用，然后每一个应用进去都能看到一个首页菜单，现在开发了吗？这个需求合理吗？帮我重新评估」
- 14:29Z 「我的工作和左侧栏的通知是不是重复了」
- 14:30Z 「同意」, answering the revised proposal: no new sidebar entry; the bell is the one todo and notification entry; the platform home page is retired; one phase-2 card.

**What this supersedes in this epic:**
- In 方向, 「侧栏…「首页」带数字」 no longer holds. The sidebar gets no 「首页」 or 「我的工作」 entry.
- Item 8 (首页搬进应用) and item 9 (首页的 AI 输入框) are dropped.
- The phase-2 acceptance lines about the sidebar 「首页」 count, the home AI input, and the same home in two apps are void.
- The interim wording in #36112 (the bell is transitional, to be replaced by the home count in phase 2) is void. The sidebar bell is the single entry for todos and notifications. Its side panel already has the 通知, 审批 and 动态 tabs.

**What stays:** item 7 (log in straight to the last-used app) and item 10 (retire the platform home, with an empty state when there are no apps). Both go into one child card: #36732. The admin setup checklist, which only the platform home shows today, needs a new place. The card thread proposes where after reading the code, and the maintainer decides.

**Not done:** a cross-app 「最近访问」. The sidebar keeps the current app's 「最近使用」.

- Owner: zone **a4-C** of seat repo:objectstack#4 (lease row on #34830).
- Waiting on: #36739 (in flight, os-warren, PR #36791). Per the epic-lane rule the split summary and the new child card are posted here once it closes.

Item 11's docs half (docs pages join the app shell) is **not** carded: it waits for the maintainer on two questions — keep both ways of opening docs or unify them; and whether closed #35424 (「全部文档页带顶栏」) is superseded. Item 12's onboarding step needs no card (the walkthrough is retired); its Studio tweaks belong to #36890.

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

## Split summary — phase 3 (2026-11-24T22:50Z)

The current batch is closed: all 10 children are closed, the last being #36739 (closed 2026-11-24T22:48Z with PR #36791).

- **Maintainer's go**, verbatim, in seat repo:objectstack#4's session (relayed to zone a4-C at 2026-11-24T18:57Z): 「#36062、#36107：后续拆卡继续」.
- **Item 11's docs half (F), ruled** — record 7142354097 on this epic, verbatim: 「「文档页并入应用外壳」（#36107 第三阶段 F A（推荐）：统一成一种外观，两个入口和旧链接都保留。」 Docs render in one appearance inside the app shell; both entry points stay; every existing docs link keeps resolving; closed #35424 is voided only in its "with the top bar" clause.

**Phase status, read at `origin/main` 2af97295:**
- Phase 1 (items 1–6): done — #36111, #36112, #36113, plus #36227, #36286, #36471.
- Phase 2: narrowed by the maintainer's 2026-11-23 ruling (comment 7104152823) — items 8 and 9 dropped; items 7 and 10 done by #36732; the bell became the full inbox page (#36741); the setup checklist follow-up #36739 is done.
- Phase 3, item 11: settings in the app menu (`AppSwitcher.tsx` 「Settings」 row) and the avatar menu's account entry are already live. The docs half is not: an app's docs pages keep the top bar at every width (`ConsoleLayout.tsx:197-290`, citing #35424), and `/docs` renders in `DefaultHomeLayout` (`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:203-222`).
- Phase 3, item 12: the Studio corner changes are done (#36501). The onboarding walkthrough is retired, so it needs no card. The shortcut close-out is not done: 「Back to home」 `⌘⇧H` is still advertised (`chrome/advertisedShortcuts.ts:74-83`, `layout/AppSwitcher.tsx:12`). The A/B/D Studio tweaks now belong to Studio epic #36890.

**Next batch (filed now as this epic's children, lane `domain:ui`, zone a4-C):**

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane |
|---|---|---|---|
| Phase 3 | G — retire or retarget the 「Back to home」 shortcut after the home retirement (S) | — | `domain:ui` |
| Phase 3 | F — docs pages join the app shell on desktop, per ruling 7142354097 (M) | — | `domain:ui` |

Order: G, then F (G is small and independent; F changes the shell's route exceptions). When both close, phase 3 and this epic are done.
